- [LGRA.5.9.4] Legal only on a `Float` slot, an `Int` slot, and a slot typed
  by a base or tier-1 unit symbol ([LUNI.4.3], [LUNI.7.3]). The compiler
  **must** refuse a `tolerance` on any other slot with
  `DS_VALIDATE_TOLERANCE_BAD_TYPE`: a tier-2 unit has no scale to convert a
  difference by ([LUNI.7.4]), and a slot typed by a dimension or scalar-group
  name names no unit to read the literal in ([LUNI.7.1]).
